controls.label: Fire
controls.hint: Which fire. Each is shaped by what is burning, from a candle wick to a tall stack of logs.

controls.label: Size
controls.hint: How big the whole fire is, against what this type starts at.

controls.label: Intensity
controls.hint: How hard it burns: low red embers of a flame at one end, a roaring yellow one at the other. Height, colour, sparks and light move together.

controls.label: Wind
controls.hint: Bends the flames, smoke and sparks over and stirs them harder, in gusts.

controls.label: Wind direction
controls.hint: Where the wind blows to, in degrees round the fire.

controls.label: Smoke
controls.hint: How thick the smoke is. 0 turns it off and saves its share of the cost.

controls.label: Sparks
controls.hint: How many sparks rise from the fire, against what the type starts with.

controls.label: Light
controls.hint: How strongly the fire lights what is around it.

controls.label: Fire resolution
controls.hint: The fire's pixels against the screen's. Half suits a game, third is for weak graphics cards, and full is finest up close at about 3 times the cost.

controls.label: Show the dressing
controls.hint: The logs, stones, torch and wall. They are not part of the effect.

controls.label: Bloom
controls.hint: The glow round the hottest parts.

controls.label: Exposure
controls.hint: How bright the whole picture is.

controls.label: Turn the view
controls.hint: Slowly turns the view around the fire until turned off.

triggers.label: Stoke
triggers.hint: The fire flares up for a couple of seconds and throws up a burst of sparks. Clicking the fire does the same.

triggers.label: Reset
triggers.hint: Everything back to the start: the campfire, every control at its default, and the view.
